parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description:
The end of the time range to query. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC.

> The end time must be later than the start time.

parameters.name: RoutineID
parameters.description: The ID of the Edge Routine that you want to query.

parameters.name: Spec
parameters.description:
The specification of the Edge Routine. Valid values:

- 5ms

- 50ms

- 100ms

parameters.name: SplitBy
parameters.description:
The dimension by which you want to group the query results. You can group the results by Edge Routine ID (routine) or specification (spec).

> If you leave this parameter empty, the query results are not grouped.

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description: The beginning of the time range to query. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC.
